description: Assess the stack an existing app runs on and recommend what to do. For each service: its plan, cost now and in 12 months, must-haves it lacks, cost jumps in the next year, lock-in, and a verdict (keep, watch, optimise, switch or fix) with savings, one-off moving cost and the month a switch pays off. Then a scorecard (cost, requirements, ready to scale, lock-in; A to F, weighted by priorities 0-3) and recommendations ranked by what the user cares about. Categories the requirements need but nothing covers are suggested too. Use the vendor ids from detect_stack; pass plan_id when the user knows their plan (otherwise the cheapest that serves today's users is assumed and said so). How to present: lead with the summary and overall grade, then the ranked recommendations with savings or added cost, then the scorecard; show every caveat and assumption word for word.

founder.description: Optional company details used only to find startup perks.

existing_customer_of.description: Vendor ids you already pay (new-customer perks are excluded).

gateways.description: Perk gateways you belong to, e.g. ["mercury", "stripe_atlas", "yc"].

mau_forecast.description: Monthly active users expected in 12 months.

priorities.description: How much each criterion matters, 0 (not at all) to 3 (most). Defaults: cost 3, requirements 3, scale 2, lock_in 1.

profile_id.description: Usage profile, e.g. b2b_saas, consumer_app, booking_marketplace, content_site, ios_on_device.

capability.description: Capability id from list_capabilities, e.g. auth.saml_sso.

source.description: The PRD sentence this came from.

unpriced.description: Services detect_stack found that the catalogue can't price (its "unknown" list).

name: audit_stack

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

completeness.description: On plan and project results: complete, complete_with_assumptions, incomplete or needs_clarification, with the reasons. Say plainly when it is not complete.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

project.description: On results about a saved project: its id and the context version the answer was computed on. Pass both back in follow-up calls.

title: Audit an existing stack
